title: FIRE - Flap Infection Risk Evaluation with an Intensive Care Infection Score
summary: The study investigates cellular blood parameters and markers of iron metabolism in intensive care patients with and without sepsis, particularly in patients following flap surgery in the oral and maxillofacial region. The aim is to correlate inflammatory and iron metabolism markers with the differential blood count and the clinical presentation of the patient in order to enable earlier detection of a potentially life-threatening blood infection (sepsis).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients undergoing oral and maxillofacial flap surgery
Exclusion criteria:
Hereditary erythrocyte disorders, e.g., sickle cell disease, hereditary spherocytosis, and hereditary hemoglobinopathies
